text: Delivered Z6 as a dependency-free, cross-platform Scala 3 Zarr codec kernel with validated CodecProgram values, explicit sync and async runtimes, generic metadata preservation, external provider proofs, standalone artifact consumption, Python and NIfTI/BIDS differential gates, and a documented NoGo on embedding a heavy fast codec in core. The resulting public seam can be extracted into a true scala-zarr artifact without architectural redesign.
